title: Will She’s The Best by Troye Sivan have above 7500000 streams during the October 09, 2026 - October 15, 2026 tracking week? Above 7.5M
rules: If She’s The Best by Troye Sivan has above 7.5M streams during the October 09, 2026 - October 15, 2026, tracking week, then the market resolves to Yes.
rules_secondary:
IMPORTANT INFORMATION: This event pertains to the U.S. and will resolve based on the value reported by Luminate’s API as of 10:00 AM ET on the Sunday immediately following the October 09, 2026 - October 15, 2026 tracking week.

Luminate Data, LLC is a neutral provider of market metrics which does not endorse, verify or participate in any way in the outcomes of any prediction market.

blind.reasoning: Kworb's data shows 'She's the Best' at only about 83k Spotify streams a day worldwide, about 8.7M total since its August 14 release. That suggests US streams across all platforms of well under 1M a week before the album came out. Even a strong album-release bump in the October 9–15 week would likely leave it around 1–2M, far short of 7.5M.
blind.falsifier: Luminate reporting the song above 7.5M US streams for Oct 9–15, for example because of a viral TikTok moment, a major sync, or a sudden spike on the Hot 100 driven by the album launch.

final.reasoning: The high price suggests the market may be counting album streams, or traders know something I don't, so I moved up from 2%. Kworb's numbers for the song itself still point to roughly 1–2M US streams this week, so I still lean NO.
